prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Rhenium (레늄) itself — the sovereign of the Rhenium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: rhenium: a dense, silvery-grey metal, the last stable element ever discovered, found in 1925 by X-ray spectroscopy and named for the Rhine; one of the rarest elements in the earth's crust, its first gram was won in 1928 from 660 kilograms of molybdenum ore, and it is still gathered from the flue dust of roasting molybdenum; it melts at 3186 degrees Celsius, after only tungsten and carbon, and a few percent in nickel superalloys keeps jet-engine turbine blades from sagging in the flame; with platinum it refines petrol, with tungsten it measures the hottest furnaces. Palette: dense dark silver, heat-tempered turbine blue, straw-gold heat tint, Rhine river grey-green.

World (fixed): the last castle of the Rhine gorge: a deep river gorge lined with castles on every cliff, and at its very end a castle of dense dark silver whose gate opens only to the last key in a long row of keyholes, above a swift bend of the river overlooked by a great singing rock. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) full plate armor from neck to feet with big rounded pauldrons and a short heraldic tabard — a solid knight's silhouette; 2) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 3) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 4) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 5) plate armor under a long heraldic tabard with a white cape to the ankles — a straight, holy silhouette; 6) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 7) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 8) dragon-scale armor covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments — a beastly, imposing silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): dense dark silver, heat-tempered turbine blue, straw-gold heat tint, Rhine river grey-green.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): dense dark silver hair with a heat-tempered sheen of blue and straw-gold like a turbine blade. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Re) and atomic number (75) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Resolved original design: choose silhouette 7, a crisp commanding officer in a knee-length open-front coat with epaulettes, belt and tall boots, fitted opaque inner bodice and short armored skirt. Her signature construction is a succession of nested keyhole-shaped dark-silver breastplate layers that close into the last golden clasp, evoking the final castle key and rare rhenium reclaimed from ore. Blue heat-tempered edges and Rhine-grey-green coat lining, straw-gold hardware. Adult late-twenties woman with warm olive skin, soft heart-shaped face, large amber eyes with calm upward corners, a playful closed-mouth half-smile, and dense dark-silver hair showing blue and straw-gold heat sheen, cut in a straight collarbone-length blunt style with eyebrow-length bangs. Bare shoulders between epaulettes and split coat sleeves, deep neckline and visible thighs, intimate areas fully opaque. Both empty natural hands visible; she rests one palm against a stone parapet, other relaxed. Front-facing with a slight hip shift, on the final castle's high gate bridge above the swift Rhine bend, great singing rock across the gorge, bright morning daylight, full body and both boots inside frame, eye-level natural perspective.
